name: smalltalk-agent
description: MCP server for AI interaction with live Smalltalk images (Squeak and Cuis). Browse classes, evaluate expressions, define methods, and run autonomous code review — all against a running Smalltalk image.
long_description:
Connect Claude to a live Smalltalk programming environment. Supports 15 tools including class browsing, method source viewing, expression evaluation, method definition, and an autonomous agent mode that delegates Smalltalk reasoning to a configurable LLM (Ollama, Anthropic, OpenAI, or xAI).

Supports three transport modes:
- **Daemon**: Unix socket to a running Smalltalk process
- **MQTT**: Remote images via MQTT broker
- **Stdio**: Launch Smalltalk VM as a subprocess

Works with Squeak and Cuis Smalltalk images.
